stem.text: A fixed amount of a gas undergoes a series of changes to its pressure and volume.
In two of the changes, no work is done by or on the gas. In one change work is done by the gas on its surroundings. In another change work is done on the gas by its surroundings.

stem.alt: Pressure against volume graph with axes labelled pressure /10^5 Pa (0 to 2.0) and volume /10^-4 m^3 (0 to 5); a closed rectangular cycle is drawn with direction arrows on each side.

stem.text: During the change when work is done on the gas by its surroundings, how much work is done on the gas?
